instruction: In apps/server/src/routes-computers.ts and routes-resources.ts, owner-only computer and machine grant endpoints (POST/PATCH /api/computers and browserOverride/desktopOverride/isDefault on machine PATCH) check c.get("ownerIdentity") directly, returning 403 on auth-off stacks where ownerIdentity is unset even though isOwnerSession(c) / requireOwnerSession(c) is true. Switch those gates to use isOwnerSession(c) / requireOwnerSession(c).

commands: pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 apps/server/test/cloak-license.test.ts apps/server/test/machine-grants.test.ts
